lastResponse.text: You’re okay, I’ll keep it short. First: call nine one one now if you’re still dizzy or feel unsafe. Say: “I’m near Union Gospel Mission in Salem, I’m overheated and dizzy, and I need help.” If you can make one more call, Mission staff is 5-0-3, 3-6-2, 3-9-8-3. Move to shade or a cool indoor spot while you call.
